job.title: reexec-evm: replay の base-fee/nonce ゲート誤判定を修正

events.rawText: psyto/reckn reexec-evm: replay set gas_price=0 with base-fee/nonce checks ON. Against a real anchor (base_fee>0) or real caller (nonce>0), revm rejected the tx pre-execution (GasPriceLessThanBasefee / NonceMismatch) and the verdict collapsed to Failed(Execution) — a wrongful refund of an honest seller. base_fee=0/nonce=0 fixtures had masked it.
